message: When should we schedule the Week 4 visit relative to Baseline, and does it need to be in person?

expect.answer: The Week 4 visit must take place in person 28 + 7 days after the Baseline Visit.

must: Compare with condition at admission, prior to study drug initiation

message: Hello, could you please confirm when a participant should be assigned to a regimen and when we should obtain their regimen-specific informed consent? Thank you.

must: Random assignment after Master Protocol eligibility is confirmed
Regimen-specific consent at the scheduled Regimen-Specific Screening Visit

message: For phone f/u, do we still need to ask about AEs, or only at in-person visits?

message: When should we conduct the Week 20 telephone visit, and what do we need to review or remind the participant about?

expect.answer: Conduct the visit by telephone 140 ± 3 days after the Baseline Visit. Check drug compliance and reinforce its importance, remind the participant to bring unused study drug to the next visit, review concomitant medications and adverse events, and review contraceptive methods used by the participant and partner.
must: 140 ± 3 days after the Baseline Visit, by telephone
Check compliance and remind participant to bring unused study drug to the next visit
Review concomitant medications, adverse events, and participant/partner contraceptive methods

Safety call information can be collected at ET Visit

message: Participant G-712-034 has used noninvasive ventilation for 23 hours a day for eight consecutive days. Does this meet the protocol definition of PAV, and which day should we record as PAV initiation?

expect.answer: Yes, this meets the PAV definition: noninvasive or invasive mechanical ventilation for more than 22 hours per day for more than seven consecutive days. Record the first day of those consecutive days as the PAV initiation date.
must: More than 22 hours/day for more than seven consecutive days
PAV initiation is the first day of the consecutive days

message: Dear Study Team, Could you please confirm whether the IND-holder/Sponsor may terminate an individual regimen without terminating the overall Master Protocol, and where we should look for any regimen-specific termination criteria? Thank you.

expect.answer: Yes, the IND-holder/Sponsor may terminate any individual regimen or the overall Master Protocol at any time. Any regimen-specific termination criteria are detailed in the RSA or Regimen Statistical Analysis Plan.
must: Yes, an individual regimen may be terminated
Criteria are in the RSA or Regimen Statistical Analysis Plan

message: Participant G-712-034 signed the Master Protocol consent but was deemed ineligible for the Master Protocol. What information do we need to collect?

expect.answer: Collect the participant’s demographic information, including age, gender, race, and ethnicity, and the reasons for Master Protocol ineligibility.

message: Hi, could you please confirm the timing of the Week 32 telephone visit and whether we should remind the participant to bring their investigational product to the Week 36 visit? Thank you.

must: Yes—bring investigational product to the Week 36 Visit

message: Wk 4 visit can only be in the afternoon and pt already dosed at home—what PKs do we need, and is this a deviation?

must: At least 1 hour apart with no dose in between

message: Participant G-712-034 was randomized within a regimen but never received the intervention. Do we still need to include them in the EDC participant log?

must: Log all participants randomized within a regimen in EDC, even if untreated

message: For participant G-712-034, is CSF collection required, and should we schedule it at Week 16 or Week 24 after Baseline?

expect.answer: CSF collection is optional for Regimen G and occurs at Baseline and Week 24, rather than Baseline and Week 16.

message: Can we give the first dose of study drug before all Baseline Visit procedures are completed?

expect.answer: No. Administer the first dose of study drug only after all Baseline Visit procedures are completed.
must: Complete Baseline Visit procedures before the first dose

message: A participant at our site stopped study drug early before completing the ATE. When should we schedule their Follow-Up Safety Call, and what do we need to cover?

expect.answer: Schedule the Follow-Up Safety Call 28 ± 3 days after the participant’s last dose of study drug. Assess and document adverse events and review the contraceptive methods being used by the participant and their partner.
must: Review participant and partner contraceptive methods

message: When should we schedule the Week 4 ATE visit, and does it need to be in person?

expect.answer: The Week 4 ATE visit must take place in person 28 ± 7 days after the Week 24 visit of the placebo-controlled portion of the trial.
must: 28 ± 7 days after the placebo-controlled Week 24 visit

message: Participant G-712-034 is finishing the 24-week double-blind treatment period. Will they receive active DNL343 in the extension even if they were assigned placebo, and for how long?

expect.answer: Yes. All participants enter the active treatment extension and receive DNL343 200 mg orally once daily for an additional 52 to 78 weeks.
must: Yes, all participants receive active DNL343 in the extension

message: Our participant completed a regimen 30 days ago, and the prior treatment has a known half-life of 8 days. They want to join another regimen. Can we re-screen and assign them now, or do we need to wait longer?

expect.answer: You need to wait until 40 days after regimen completion before re-screening and assignment to another regimen. The required interval is 30 days or 5 known half-lives, whichever is longer.
must: 30 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer
Wait until 40 days after regimen completion

message: What is the primary efficacy endpoint, and through which week is it assessed?

expect.answer: The primary efficacy endpoint is change from baseline through Week 24 in disease severity as measured by ALSFRS-R total score and survival.

message: Where do we need to document assessments missed because of pandemic-related restrictions?

message: Participant G-734-018 plans to use abstinence for contraception. How long must she remain abstinent, and would calendar-based periodic abstinence qualify?

must: 90 days after last dose of study drug

message: Participant G-712-034 wants to withdraw consent for use of their biofluid samples. Can they do this now, and can samples already used be destroyed?

Repeat before the second lumbar puncture, as defined in the RSA

message: For in-clinic dosing, can the person giving the drug also do the dose/pt ID check, or do we need a 2nd staff member?
